backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Metadata file mapping implemented features to related source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of all frontend files related to the home page.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base configuration and global CSS variables defining the site's color system, theming, and core styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML template loading fonts and mounting the app root with the main React script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Renders the HomePage component as the root of the app.
frontend/src/components/home/HeaderNav.t: Responsive navigation header with scrollspy, smooth scrolling, and mobile menu behavior.
frontend/src/components/home/sections/Ab: About section displaying agency intro text and three highlight cards with icons and animations.
frontend/src/components/home/sections/Ct: CTA section with a gradient background and buttons that smooth-scroll to targeted sections.
frontend/src/components/home/sections/Fe: Featured projects grid using content data, animated cards, and hover interactions.
frontend/src/components/home/sections/Fo: Renders the site footer with link groups, social icons, and smooth-scroll navigation.
frontend/src/components/home/sections/He: Displays the hero banner with animated visuals, tagline, and buttons that smooth-scroll to sections.
frontend/src/components/home/sections/Se: Renders a grid of service cards using homeContent data with scroll reveal animations.
frontend/src/components/home/sections/St: Shows statistical highlights in a branded section with animated reveal effects.
frontend/src/components/home/sections/Te: Displays testimonial cards with quotes and avatars using homeContent data and scroll reveal.
frontend/src/components/motion/ScrollRev: A wrapper component that animates children into view using an IntersectionObserver hook.
frontend/src/content/homeContent.ts: Defines structured content for services, projects, and testimonials used across homepage sections.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, exposing identity state, login, logout, and status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useInView.ts: Custom hook providing an IntersectionObserver-based in-view state for triggering animations.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file intended for future React Query hooks.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollSpy.ts: Implements a scroll spy hook that tracks which section ID is currently active based on scroll position and an offset.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, custom OKLCH color variables, animations, reduced‑motion rules, and global UI behaviors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Assembles the home page layout by rendering header, hero, content sections, and footer components.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, animations, container settings, and plugin integrations.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s state, scope, features, image requirements, and architectural notes.
